name: ExergyNet MCP Gateway
description: Model Context Protocol gateway at exergynet.org/mcp for submitting verifiable compute jobs and retrieving their content-addressed (SHA-256) receipts. Ed25519-authenticated. A returned receipt is a SHA-256 content hash, not a Groth16 or ZK-STARK proof, and does not by itself prove execution; on-chain ZK verification is in development and not yet enforcing. For persistent local agent memory use VMN (npm @lnes/vanguard-memory-node); this endpoint does not itself expose memory or authority tools.
